method: Pre-emptive restriction catalogue (RESEARCH:58) — historical slide → segment closure rule before disaster. Like JMA's pre-emptive restriction sections. Restrictions are advisory (RESTRICT) even when segment is physically open, based on forecast + SWI + local threshold.

R1.rule: Restrict if effective_rain ≥ local_threshold and SWI ≥0.35 or isolation may_isolate

R2.rule: Restrict if ridge shortcut S1 score ≥65 (Moderate) and isolated or SWI ≥0.40; never emergency route

R3.rule: Restrict only if effective_rain ≥450 and SWI ≥0.45 — valley emergency route stays open

R4.rule: Restrict if effective_rain ≥500 or SWI ≥0.50 — last egress, highest bar

catalogue_note: Counts from GSI Bhusanket 30k vs OSM highway buffer 200m (data/sih26001/evidence/sikkim_join.json). Not a legal order — officer confirms via field queue.
